title: Regioisomerism-guided interfacial design toward stable zinc metal anodes
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE04705F, Paper
Jiaming Li, Hanhao Liang, Nan Li, Junyi Han, Jiaqi Li, Hedong Gu, Shaoyu Zhang, Jianhang Huang, Zhanhong Yang, Yongyao Xia
This work highlights the crucial role of regioisomerism in additive design, demonstrating that picolinamide enables uniform zinc deposition and excellent cycling stability through a stable bidentate adsorption configuration.
